story.title: Country Quiz
story.ctaText: How many did you get? Comment 👇

questions.q: Which country has the **most people** in South America?
The old walled city of **Dubrovnik** is in…?
Which country drinks the most **coffee** per person?
The **Maasai Mara** reserve is in which country?

lines.q: Which country is home to the city of Marrakech?
Which country has the most people in South America?
lines.a: Brazil! More than two hundred million, by far the biggest.

lines.q: The old walled city of Dubrovnik is in which country?
lines.a: Croatia! Its walls run almost two kilometres around the old town.

lines.q: Which country drinks the most coffee per person?
lines.a: Finland! Around twelve kilos a year each. Italy isn't even close.

lines.q: The Maasai Mara reserve is in which country?
lines.a: Kenya! It runs right into Tanzania's Serengeti, so close call.

lines.q: Last one. Which country has the most pyramids?
lines.a: Sudan! Over two hundred, about twice as many as Egypt. Six out of six? Go again and prove it!
